items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I use Emil all the way through on trombone along with Bob Havens... I gave him a band also

ctx.x: I'm confused on this record myself. I've never listened to it so much as I should have, but I know there are two trombones on it. Can you remember which tunes Emil plays any solo? Oh,

yeah. Well, of course, in the later years, Emil went to bass. He gave up the trombone. But when I give this session to Emil, I had to have him on some trombone parts. So I got a good band back, Emil. I got Mike Lala, good trumpet man here, good lead trumpet man, and Harry Shields on clarinet, and Bob Havens, who's one of the real fine trombone players here around New Orleans today. Of course, Joe Cupero on banjo and Monk Hazel on drums, Armand Hug on piano. And I thought I would record a few tunes, and one or two…
So Christian only plays trombone on a couple of the numbers.
